implementation: Oblivious GPU prediction reuses exact shared packed metadata in bounded consecutive mixed-depth tree launches; host uses exact vector split records, byte-budgeted row tiles and row-owned ordered folds. Non-symmetric GPU prediction packs eight integer node words, traverses once per row/tree for all output planes in model-byte-bounded tree groups, retains exact cursor adds in ascending tree order; host uses exact vector node records within original checked walk/refusal order. Bias, NaN/categorical preparation and link functions remain existing callers.
remaining_gaps: Standalone non-resident oblivious legacy prediction does not use the resident model arm; public resident prediction and host archive inference are wired.
Packing/preparation cost is inside inference boundary; no speed improvement is established.

Categorical, ordered and ranking resident models retain existing preprocessing/archive guards. Unsupported combined simple-CTR/tensor-CTR or missing archive-table configurations are not newly supported.
